turns.query: Summarise Beijing's 2024 air quality for an annual review as one number: the year's mean daily city AQI under the national standard HJ 633-2012, over the city's assessment points. Report that mean, and how many different pollutants take the lead on at least one day.

A colleague proposes a shortcut for the same summary: average each pollutant over the whole of 2024 first, run the six annual means through the sub-index tables once, and take the largest. Report the figure that shortcut produces, and say whether it can stand in for the one you already computed.
